title: different BG readings
symptom: The user is using xDrip+ with Miao Miao and gets different BG readings compared to the official Libre scanner, and asks if xDrip+ can use the same algorithm as the official scanner.
fix: xDrip allows different algorithms to calculate BG readings. To get results similar to the scanner, the user is directed to the LibreOOPAlgorithm repository.
evidence_quote: xdrip allows different algorithms to calculate bg readings. To get results similar to the scanner, please see https://github.com/tzachi-dar/LibreOOPAlgorithm
